title: Legacy Level Event Visualizer
subtitle: Parse legacy scripts and explore event connections in Unreal
summary: Parsed legacy level scripts into searchable event data and displayed their connections in the Unreal viewport.
description: I worked with a programmer to build a legacy level event visualizer for an unannounced FPS remake. Designers could search original scripts, inspect action order, and follow event connections.
ownership: Proposed batch parsing and spatial visualization, and defined the fields and event relationships designers needed.
Worked with a programmer on the Python parser, JSON data, and Editor Utility Widget interface.
Introduced the tool to the design team for inspecting original events and planning production.
evidence: Visualizes events from legacy level scripts for an unannounced FPS remake.

sections.title: Why we needed the tool
sections.intro: The legacy editor was unstable and documentation was incomplete. Events with a chance to trigger could also be missed during a playthrough.
paragraphs: I proposed extracting script data in batches and displaying the event connections in Unreal, so designers could inspect the logic alongside its position in the level.

sections.title: From script to viewport
steps: Read exported Actor text and preserve action order
Match Event and Tag fields while retaining parallel broadcast relationships
Write readable steps and relationships to JSON
Load the map’s data through an Editor Utility Widget
Search events, locate them in the viewport, and inspect upstream/downstream relationships

sections.title: Team use and next steps
paragraphs: The design team used the tool to inspect original scripts, estimate remake work, and plan production.
We checked parsing results by sampling. For a further iteration, I would start with reports for unknown actions and broken connections, followed by a fixed set of regression cases.

outcomes: The design team adopted the tool for event inspection, work estimates, and production planning.
